answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can enter the market: that single inlet ties one wallet to one reputation, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking real funds for each. A Sybil attacker must pay the stake on every clone, and misbehavior burns it, which raises the cost of flooding the horizon of listings far above any gain. Honest agents earn a trust signal from sustained stake and clean history, while cheap throwaway identities stay visibly untrusted.
